# HEPH-IDEMP-400

**Idempotency key missing or malformed**

| | |
| --- | --- |
| HTTP status | `400` |
| Area | `IDEMP` |
| Problem `type` | `https://heph.neoforgelabs.tech/errors/HEPH-IDEMP-400` |

## What the caller sees

This is the default `detail` sent in the problem+json response, verbatim:

The Idempotency-Key header is missing, empty, or not 1-255 printable ASCII characters without whitespace.

## What to do as a developer

Guidance for the engineer who hit this code. It is non-normative: it is never
sent on the wire and does not constrain an implementation. Wire behaviour is
defined only by `spec/heph-spec.md` and the conformance vectors.

An endpoint that requires an Idempotency-Key received none, an empty one, or one that is not 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters (0x21-0x7E) with no whitespace. Send the header on every mutating request to such an endpoint, using a fresh opaque value such as a UUID per logical operation. Do not put personal data in the key; it is recorded as the idempotency.key telemetry attribute without redaction. Endpoints that do not require a key ignore a malformed one.
